en-US.description: A cross-platform music tagger powered by the MusicBrainz database.
en-US.longDescription:
MusicBrainz Picard is a cross-platform music file tagger.
Your music files don’t just contain music. They also contain “metadata”, consisting of “tags” which consist of a tag name or type and associated data, for example the album or track name, the name of the artist, the record label, the year of issue etc. Unless you rip the music files yourself with a very basic tool, your music files probably already contain some basic metadata, however there are literally hundreds of tags that can be applied to your music if you are interested.
Obviously, if you wanted to you could painstakingly research all this information for each album and track individually, and type the data into a tagging tool, but clearly it makes more sense in this internet connected age for one person to do this for each album and track, to upload that data to a shared database and then for the tagging tool to access that database and use the data to tag the music files. And that is what MusicBrainz Picard does.
MusicBrainz is the database, and Picard is the tool that tags the music files.

en-US.releaseNotes:
Bugfixes
- PICARD-3511 - Saving embedded artwork fails when setting the artwork for multiple selected files
- PICARD-3525 - Restore Defaults uses wrong values for plugins
- PICARD-3538 - Unable to change cover art provider order
- PICARD-3541 - Views stay suspended and the pending files count never reaches zero when a file is removed while it is still loading
- PICARD-3542 - "Automatically cluster all new files" can skip clustering depending on which file finishes loading last
- PICARD-3543 - CD lookup reads a wrong drive name when the CD lookup devices setting has spaces or empty items
- PICARD-3550 - After filtering the "Unmatched Files" entry shows up for all loaded releases
- PICARD-3554 - Hovering over the closing % of a variable shows an empty tooltip
- PICARD-3556 - CLI: command alias "plugin uninstall" not working
- PICARD-3559 - Crash on logout error if option window was closed
Improvements
- PICARD-3553 - Allow setting PICARD_FORCE_FUSION=0 to opt-out of using Qt's Fusion style

zh-CN.description: 由 MusicBrainz 数据库支持的跨平台音乐标记工具。
zh-CN.longDescription:
MusicBrainz Picard 是一款跨平台音乐文件标记工具。
音乐文件不仅包含音乐，还包含“元数据”，由“标签”组成。“标签”由标签名称或类型以及相关数据组成，例如专辑或曲目名称、艺术家姓名、唱片公司、发行年份等。除非你亲自用最基本的工具翻录音乐文件，你的音乐文件可能已经包含了一些基本的元数据。
当然，如果你愿意，你可以单独为每张专辑和每首曲目煞费苦心地研究所有这些信息，然后将数据输入标签工具。但在这个互联网时代，为每张专辑和每首曲目做这些工作，并将数据上传到共享数据库，然后让标签工具访问该数据库并使用这些数据给音乐文件打上标签，显然更有意义。而这正是 MusicBrainz Picard 所要做的。
MusicBrainz 是数据库，而 Picard 则是标记音乐文件的工具。
